wholePhysicalScope: Named native five-point tower footprint and the sign of its public square frontage.
lodDetails: Four levels retain the sandstone tower, bronze dial group, banded brick walls, slate pyramid and rear canopy. Near levels resolve the dials, cross windows, stone bands and clock hatches.
limitations: The exterior represents March 2010. The museum’s three surveyed-by-operator height figures control the main silhouette. Intermediate roof and opening dimensions and the sheltered stairs are estimated.
The clock layout is original simplified geometry based on the visible arrangement of concentric dials. Small dial graphics, figures and inscriptions are simplified.
Original public elevation samples are preserved. Approach paving and individual steps are approximate.
